notes.title: Ocean Keeper Co-op Beta Announced – Closed Beta Launches This Month
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey Guardians![/b][/h2][p]
It has been a long journey...[/p][p]When we first released [b]Ocean Keeper: Dome Survival[/b], we wanted to create a world that felt vast, alive, and worth protecting – even when you stand alone against the waves. Over time, [i]Ocean Keeper reached players on all major platforms, and your feedback shaped it into the adventure it is today.[/i]
[/p][p]Our game was not only our first multiplatform release – [b]it was a test that showed what our team was capable of[/b]. From early access to a full launch on all major consoles, we've walked this path with you. And now... it's time to move on.
[/p][p]Trends in game development have shown us something interesting — [i]cooperative adventures have a special magic[/i]. They bring players together, turn tense moments into shared stories, and make victories even more meaningful. So we asked ourselves: what if the depths of Ocean Keeper could be explored... together? 
[/p][previewyoutube="c5IlSr57vX0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
We are excited to officially announce our next standalone project – [b]Ocean Keeper Co-op[/b]! Yes, that's right – the underwater roguelike you know and love is back, this time for [b]4[/b] players. But it's not just the same game with extra seats – [i]it's a fresh take with new mechanics, resource gathering with friends, and defense mechanisms at the center of the action.[/i] 

We've been developing it for a while now, and [b]every day the whole team gets together to test the game[/b]. Even in these early stages, it's already turning into something fun, chaotic, and full of memorable moments.
We’re taking everything we learned from developing the original [b]Ocean Keeper[/b] – every challenge we faced, every bit of feedback you shared – and using it to make Ocean Keeper Co-op the [b]most exciting[/b], [b]fun[/b], and [b]engaging experience[/b] we can create.

And here's the best part – you'll be able to join us very soon. [b]This month, we're opening a closed beta for Ocean Keeper Co-op.[/b] You'll be among the first to try it out, test new features, and most importantly, defend your mech and gather resources side by side with your friends. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/98408dd1d39114bc3ea3598022e2fea68292b237.png"][/img]All the details on how to join the beta test will be posted on our [url="https://discord.gg/v7ee6GFc3a"][b]Discord[/b][/url] soon, so don't miss the announcement. 

We can't wait to hear the stories you and your team bring back from the depths. 
[/p][p][b]— The Ocean Keeper Team[/b] [/p]

notes.title: Ocean Keeper 1.0.3: PS5 Release, Cross-Platform Deals & New Features
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Guardians![/h2]

We’re thrilled to announce the release of [b]Ocean Keeper 1.0.3 update[/b], bringing a host of exciting new features, fixes, and improvements. This update includes the new Relic Fun system, offering temporary boosters to enhance your mining and combat experience, alongside several gameplay improvements based on your feedback. Additionally, we’ve worked hard to balance the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/31c9566e9633eec16206b923d2454d545d14c854.jpg[/img]
But that’s not all – [b]Ocean Keeper 1.0.0 is now available on[/b] [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UB1177-PPSA26288_00-0295650486691413][b]PlayStation[/b][/url] for the first time, with all the exciting updates and improvements now accessible to console players. To make this launch even more special, we’re offering massive discounts on both [b]Steam (up to 25%)[/b] and [b]PlayStation (20% off)[/b], with an additional [b]20%[/b] off for [b]PlayStation Plus[/b] members. Don’t miss out on the chance to grab the new and improved game at a reduced price!

[i]Let’s dive deeper into everything that’s included in this patch:[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/c3a8119f001dbb32a64911cc5bfd8418e47d61c7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/5b4747a158bc7bb24f0e0780704adeb01bf4a06e.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Plus Time[/b]: Adds extra time to the wave countdown.
[*] [b]Armageddon[/b]: Calls in a rocket barrage around the Mech
[*] [b]Mines Trail[/b]: Mines drop behind the Mech as it moves.
[*] [b]Reflector[/b]: Long-range attacks are reflected back at enemies (Spit enemies).
[*] [b]Skill Reload Time[/b]: Reduces skill reload time by a percentage during a wave.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/5709c1a645d096054bae2e379b93523ff003ed13.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/b7c256031a28594478a862e4fbcaedb2e2ab9534.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/d66a4f1af15f23d74c0306c1b6f4bc58c197a47a.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/afc3cfd517769e076025878b9a1f93864111b01d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Anti Gravity Ore[/b]: Ore and other objects now float instead of sinking during digging.
[*] [b]Double Ore[/b]: All ore blocks now yield double the amount.
[*] [b]Ore XRay[/b]: See ore through blocks and fog of war.
[*] [b]Mega Explosion[/b]: The Digger drops bombs (new bombs spawn every few seconds).
[*] [b]Corrosion swarm[/b]: Every few seconds, a random block within a certain radius of the Digger will break.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/7eacefac903f8e584eee4558f62b060f19239e77.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/4fc5879cf228357a15ad2a822f84d958506f613a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/61ec4dcf1dd93b5e1c7d8fa3cb5277eaa00006f5.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/8ccbd8bffcc41e752f8c8676d9ec65681bbe5060.png[/img]
[h3]Localization:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Renamed some session upgrades for the Digger’s tools.
[*] Fixed missing Dialogue Summary in the journal.
[*] Renamed ore in Steam Achievements and changed the name of the meta-currency to Oceanit.
[*] Reduced dialogue speed for easier reading.[/list]
[h3]Settings:[/h3]
We’ve reworked several UI elements in the settings menu, making it more streamlined and user-friendly. The addition of a save feature for graphics settings and the improved tab organization ensures that customizing your gameplay experience is even easier than before.
[list]
[*] Merged “General” and “Controls” tabs.
[*] Added a “Save” button for graphics settings.
[*] Changed the order of settings on the "Graphics" tab.
[/list]
[h3]VFX:[/h3]
In this update, we’ve made significant improvements to the visual effects (VFX) in Ocean Keeper to enhance the overall gameplay experience. These changes aim to make explosions, projectiles, and enemy interactions more impactful and visually appealing, adding to the intensity of your undersea adventures.[list]
[*] Updated explosion effects for all in-game explosions, enhancing the visual impact.
[*] Fixed Rail Gun shooting effects for more fluid gameplay.
[*] Made projectiles and trails more noticeable for various weapons like:[/list][olist]
[*] Sniper Rifle
[*] Artillery
[*] Detonation Charges
[*] Carpet Missile Launcher
[*] Rocket Gun[/olist][list]
[*] Updated enemy death explosions to match enemy size and damage effects across multiple enemy types.
[*] Updated puddles effects for Electric and Freezing Puddles.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/d1c050847054f388b7b27a810c6dff4743553db8.gif[/img]

[h3]Level Design:[/h3]
We’ve made significant improvements to level design, particularly in the handling of object colliders. This change ensures that environmental interactions are smooth and intuitive.
[list]
[*] Fixed colliders not matching object sizes.
[/list]
[h3]Story Indicator Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed antenna radius for locating points of interest, improving the navigation and exploration experience.
[/list]
[h3]Balance:[/h3]
We’ve carefully reviewed and refined the game’s balance, ensuring that progression feels rewarding while also maintaining the challenge. These tweaks address issues raised by our community and improve the overall gameplay experience.
[list]
[*] Adjusted the balance for Wave 4.
[*] Fixed an issue where the spawn rate of worm groups was too high.
[*] Corrected the group sizes of enemies in later waves.
[/list]
[h3]Credits:[/h3]
As part of the 1.0.3 update, we’ve also added Credits to the game after the completion of the main storyline. We’d like to express our gratitude to everyone who contributed to Ocean Keeper's development, from our team to the community. Beta testers can now find their names in the credits if they contributed to the development of Ocean Keeper.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/f533745e4c4b050b09c53a10bf579ad61f51956a.png[/img]

Wow, you made it this far. We hope you’re enjoying the new updates. We’re continuing to work hard on improvements, and we’re excited to hear what you think.

Play [b]Ocean Keeper 1.0.0 now on [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UB1177-PPSA26288_00-0295650486691413]PlayStation[/url][/b], with the full experience coming soon to other platforms like Xbox, Switch, and mobile.

We’re always listening — your feedback is invaluable, so don’t hesitate to share it with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/f35e9b98511cec7d3b7d9460be2f7413667411f9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 1.0.0 - Now Available and Optimized for Steam Deck
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Guardians![/h2] 

We know many of you have been asking why the Steam Deck version of Ocean Keeper didn’t receive the [b]1.0 update[/b] alongside the full Steam release. The answer is simple: we needed a bit more time to ensure everything was properly optimized for Steam Deck. But now, we’re happy to announce that the update is live, and you can enjoy the [b]latest version of Ocean Keeper on your Steam Deck.[/b]

While the game was previously marked as "Playable," this update ensures a smoother experience and brings us one step closer to receiving the official "[b]Verified[/b]" badge from Steam.
We’re also working on porting the latest version of the game to consoles, including [b]Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch[/b], and will keep you updated on progress.

Thank you for your feedback. We’re continually working to fix any issues and improve the game, so your experience gets better with each update. We’ll keep listening and refining the game.

notes.title: FAQ After Launch – Version 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Guardians![/h2]
First off, a huge thank you to everyone who’s joined us on this incredible journey since the official release of Ocean Keeper on Steam! We’ve seen an amazing response from players, and we truly appreciate all your support. We’ve also noticed some common questions and feedback across Steam and Discord, so we wanted to take a moment to address them here.

[h1]1. Why Did My Saves Disappear After the Release?[/h1]
This has been the most asked question, and we totally understand the frustration. The reason your progress was reset is due to some key changes we made to the game. We’ve added a new storyline and locked many weapons and upgrades that will now unlock gradually as you progress through the story. Our aim was to provide a more organic gameplay experience where players explore and progress naturally, without feeling overpowered right from the start. Additionally, with all the new content we’ve added and some things we’ve removed, it was difficult to maintain saves in the previous format.

[h1]2. Why Is the Update Only Available on Steam? When Will It Be Available on Other Platforms?[/h1]
We know many of you are eager to play Ocean Keeper on Xbox, PlayStation, mobile, and Steam Deck. The main priority for us was the full release on Steam, and we’re now focusing on bringing the game to Steam Deck first, including getting full verification from Steam that the game works seamlessly on it. After that, our next major focus will be fixing bugs and porting the updated version to other platforms like Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch. Rest assured, we’re working as quickly as we can to make sure Ocean Keeper is available and polished across all platforms.

[h1]3. What About the Reward for Players Who Played Before the Release?[/h1]
We know it can be disappointing to lose progress, especially after investing time in the game. As a thank you to those who played before the official release, we’re rolling out an update today that will reward you with a special bonus to help you progress faster in the game. Check out the details below for what you can expect!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/4cc692a72f9501bde7d78ec49668c892f9024c38.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/7962d3a47acc46587db1935cbb6d0a3e4423165b.jpg[/img]
Once again, thank you for your continued support and feedback. We’re reading everything and making improvements where we can. If we haven’t responded to you yet, don’t worry — we’re on it and will get back to everyone as soon as possible.

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, happy adventuring!
— The Ocean Keeper Team

notes.title: Ocean Keeper Officially Released
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Guardians![/h2]

What started as a small experimental project has grown into a full-fledged game — with a complete story, updated visuals, new mechanics, and countless improvements inspired by your feedback.

Today, we’re proud to officially release version 1.0 on Steam. Thank you for being part of this journey — whether you’ve been with us from the start or just joined now. Welcome to the full Ocean Keeper experience!

Below, we’ve highlighted some of the key features included in the 1.0 release — though there are far more changes and additions under the surface. We’ll focus on the most exciting ones!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/6beeb5f18a1abfc40177d049057c39b481141ac4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/c0069681439d6358726b83837dc7acb531c22c0f.png[/img]
We’ve been working on a storyline that will provide a more meaningful role to the exploration and combat. In this release, we carefully integrate all narrative elements into the roguelike structure to maintain replayability while delivering a smooth feeling of constant progression.

We've included and fully localized over 500 lines of story dialogues, and completely redesigned the tutorial - now it functions as an integrated part of the story. Also, we've updated five main points of interest to reflect their narrative importance.

We've added in-world notes that reveal Ocean Keeper's lore and explain the events that led to the current state of the underwater world. In addition, we've added the Digger’s personal diary and a story journal that will help track the major developments throughout the roguelike loops. Expect more interaction between the two main characters, the Mech and the Digger, and a new third character that will reveal unexpected details about Ocean Keeper world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/54c7c2bb70bca1a0158f5ad359401817b3f0b344.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/2e308c421a11c13d5a2a6f5d717f79e98c0b530d.png[/img]
We’ve completed a full visual redesign, including adjusted lighting, color grading, and environmental layering to improve performance and gameplay clarity. As a result, new game graphics better reflect the dark atmosphere of the Ocean Keeper.

We've also improved points of interest. Now, each POI looks visually richer and has a significant meaning to the narrative. Enemies have received visual upgrades as well - they have glowing elements and enhanced effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/f0f947f745c9c3ae94e8275bc64ccddabe07a666.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/b43ebb91900360d0ad18e0947f77dba6fd245570.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/e4b9b5ed5cce523d9e53999f5fd221b56f8ae95a.png[/img]
We’ve updated the UI to offer clearer structure, improve readability, and help players better navigate the game. Also, our goal was to provide a more responsive and intuitive experience.

We've reworked several core windows, including the Main Menu, Settings, Pause, and Customization screens, as well as in-game HUDs for the Mech and Digger. The Settings window now features a tab-based layout for better organization. Navigation with keyboard and gamepad also has been improved across multiple screens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/8e3274990c1732e75c8d76ecb5077b44eab49d4e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/5c3a79ddf46af13138c26014ec2c006012a38d89.png[/img]

We’ve reworked core balance systems to make the game more tactically engaging. We've improved progression systems - weapon stats and upgrades are now divided into tiers, and session progression got clearer upgrade choices. Also, we have rebalanced Mech's speed and enemy waves for better pacing and diversity.

We've updated cave generation and ore spawning to increase exploration depth. Now, players must effectively upgrade Digger to gather enough resources and survive increasingly difficult waves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/460da628ec9b49294bb79916e67eb44f8932728b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/b79c03b49de98113f4ac8a354d3432e11cc5c76e.png[/img]

We’ve expanded the enemy system to provide more tactical depth. Now, Ocean Keeper features around 30 enemy types: some enemies explode on contact, others keep their distance and attack from range.

We've enhanced boss mechanics with new attack patterns and improvements to existing ones. Each boss now presents a more challenging encounter, and defeating a boss grants a reward, giving players access to a free upgrade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/abf9807b4618717c1c0cbc27149c522038882b8b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/d049ad9ad68ed9cc58f2d1ce70c5aab71b8aa8ff.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/836ab265daf20ce950f0540464eff9836cc6cee2.png[/img]

Ocean Keeper release also includes several important improvements outside the core systems. We've developed new weapons, tools, and updated sound design and cave environments.

[b]New Mech Weapons[/b] 
We've created two new weapons for the Mech: the Rail Gun, which pierces through multiple enemies, and the Electric Gun, which fires an electric projectile dealing area damage.

[b]New Digger Tools[/b] 
We've created two additional tools for the Digger: the Punch Glove that smashes through blocks, and the Laser Glove, that melts through blocks in a straight line.

[b]Sounds Update[/b] 
We've reworked all in-game sounds, including weapon audio, enemy effects, UI sounds, and cave ambiences.

[b]Cave Update[/b] 
We've improved core caves - now they feature greater variety and include optional challenges that reward extra resources. We've also improved lighting and stronger underwater ambiance for cave visuals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/31cea7089c3977b15227777e6cfe52d932d300d1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/f3b244c81d5c0b162f39954df0fbdff4573ddef8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/50008b7c4e4990141d8fe83df412a0be9a92348a.png[/img]
We also invite you to check out our brand-new official trailer. It reflects how far the game has come and sets the tone for what awaits in version 1.0. We’d love to hear what you think!

[previewyoutube=1ZX7i0791zQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/42196f9f6b8112c478b5d6f46d5ae8fdec88f832.png[/img]
Ocean Keeper is leaving Early Access. This isn’t just another update – it’s part of our story.

When we launched Ocean Keeper in Early Access, we had a concept.
A world after disaster.
A mech guarding the last fragments of life.
A drill digging through the sand.
We had a clear vision for tone, mood, and gameplay – but at that point, it was just a shell.

Everything that came after was shaped by the people around us.
By players leaving feedback on Discord and Steam.
By friends testing early builds late at night.
By family who had no idea what was happening on screen, but still said, “It looks cool.”
And by our team – making mistakes, fixing them, and pushing forward.

Ocean Keeper is no longer “just a roguelike.”
It’s a world – one built through fragments of story, dialogue, and discovery. It’s a game where each wave, each mine, and each moment of quiet holds meaning. Not just for the player, but for the people who built it.

And today, we’re proud to say: Ocean Keeper 1.0 is here.

We’re not done – not even close. This isn’t an ending, but a new chapter.
There are more updates coming, console versions on the horizon, patches, and polish to be done — and most importantly, there’s a growing community to build alongside.

To everyone who supported us – and to those joining now – thank you.
It’s been a long journey. But we’re only just diving in.

— The Ocean Keeper Team

Enemies have received visual upgrades as well - they have glowing elements and enhanced effects.
We’ve updated the UI to offer clearer structure, improve readability, and help players better navigate the game.
Also, our goal was to provide a more responsive and intuitive experience.
We've reworked several core windows, including the Main Menu, Settings, Pause, and Customization screens, as well as in-game HUDs for the Mech and Digger.
The Settings window now features a tab-based layout for better organization.
Navigation with keyboard and gamepad also has been improved across multiple screens.

tags.balance_change: We've improved progression systems - weapon stats and upgrades are now divided into tiers, and session progression got clearer upgrade choices.
Also, we have rebalanced Mech's speed and enemy waves for better pacing and diversity.
We've updated cave generation and ore spawning to increase exploration depth.
Now, players must effectively upgrade Digger to gather enough resources and survive increasingly difficult waves.

tags.feature: We’ve expanded the enemy system to provide more tactical depth.
Now, Ocean Keeper features around 30 enemy types: some enemies explode on contact, others keep their distance and attack from range.
We've enhanced boss mechanics with new attack patterns and improvements to existing ones.

tags.balance_change: Each boss now presents a more challenging encounter, and defeating a boss grants a reward, giving players access to a free upgrade.

tags.feature: Ocean Keeper release also includes several important improvements outside the core systems.
We've developed new weapons, tools, and updated sound design and cave environments.
We've created two new weapons for the Mech: the Rail Gun, which pierces through multiple enemies, and the Electric Gun, which fires an electric projectile dealing area damage.
We've created two additional tools for the Digger: the Punch Glove that smashes through blocks, and the Laser Glove, that melts through blocks in a straight line.
We've reworked all in-game sounds, including weapon audio, enemy effects, UI sounds, and cave ambiences.
We've improved core caves - now they feature greater variety and include optional challenges that reward extra resources.
We've also improved lighting and stronger underwater ambiance for cave visuals.

notes.title: What's Next for Ocean Keeper?
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Guardians! [/h2]

Lately, we’ve been getting a lot of questions like, "When’s the next update?" and "What’s next for the project?" In this post, we’ll answer those questions and share our plans for the future.

Ocean Keeper has been in Early Access for quite some time. During this period, we’ve added new content, tested features, and gathered a ton of feedback from Steam and our Discord community. We’re incredibly grateful to everyone who has shared their thoughts and helped us make the game better.

Now, Ocean Keeper is moving toward its final stage - the full release. Before that, we may release one or two major updates, but the team is now primarily focused on making the full release as polished as possible.

What are we working on right now? We would like to share some WIP materials with you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/5e7854d8ce5744af2566b18a5be3b3ace325d2b7.png[/img]

We’re aiming to significantly enhance the game’s graphics, including reworked models, textures, lighting, and the overall atmosphere of the underwater world. New biomes, environments, and visual effects will make the game even more immersive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/9ddd405e09df3a1285d80ce0b0b1dc748221b33b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/c80d4f214cfb4948f28b711dab456ca69aa8d820.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/54f6859d931cdbc68bfe6f17e59031849e0abba8.png[/img]

We’re actively redesigning the user interface, focusing on both aesthetics and usability. The new UI will not only look more polished but also make navigating menus and managing upgrades much more intuitive and seamless.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/790f23a5229f8b74285ad7af59055bb0801e9801.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/3ac054dee0781b3aabc19d50a2940ce40af0db21.png[/img]

We’re working to make the underwater world not only dangerous but also filled with mysteries. We’re crafting a thoughtful and engaging storyline for Ocean Keeper. Expect unique characters, deep lore, and immersive storytelling that will add a whole new layer to the underwater adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/2fc4eea025d24d376fcc0a6d5fd01a6bfc6f66da.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/98fbd3c277eaedbd9fb096287af52359232dee53.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/38d16760b629f552d306712a432adfc8acdda109.png[/img]

We’re hard at work revamping the animations for existing bosses and mobs (yes, that includes the crab). The goal is to bring more life and fluidity to their movements, making encounters feel dynamic and immersive. Alongside this, we’re introducing a roster of new enemies, each with unique designs and animations to keep the gameplay fresh and engaging.
In parallel, significant efforts are being poured into balancing these encounters to ensure every fight feels fair yet challenging. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/4b7ee4cbc120dcce172e7dd295eba209f442d818.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/d8880f2de2698dca6bc0f67d82ac83d5a9f9352e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/883394ee81d48d1cd45cab8097e80245686d3fb7.png[/img]

We’re actively improving the design and atmosphere of the game’s caves and special locations. For the standard caves, we’re enhancing the environment by working on lighting effects, adding atmospheric elements like fog, and integrating vibrant underwater decor such as corals. These adjustments aim to make exploration more immersive and visually captivating.

For the unique points of interest, we’re focusing on redesigning puzzles to make them more engaging and rewarding. We’re also refining the visual clarity of interactive elements, such as resource blocks and objects, to ensure they stand out naturally within the environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/68473b53fc4a8dfab6e0077cf16c592c9437bbd9.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/a80563455e42a1b9cb2dca4717c86088a820e515.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/81e1f602d77e20010d0850a9a0f93850f8d91e31.png[/img]

We’re dedicating significant effort to enhancing the audio experience in the game. This includes creating new sound effects for mobs, bosses, and weapons, as well as refining the ambiance to better reflect the underwater setting. Each sound is carefully crafted to immerse you deeper into the mysterious depths of the ocean.

Additionally, our team is working on a revamped musical score, designed to accompany your journey and adapt dynamically to in-game events—whether it’s exploring eerie caves, battling intense waves of enemies, or facing off against formidable bosses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/fa1121fac6b2e884a9f7dd40fb72b1cf5a1e503b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/8362c252fea1712e3446fc448b8ac4c6b7656229.png[/img]

Our team of developers and artists have been hard at work creating amazing updates. Exciting new story elements, stunning visual enhancements, updated gameplay mechanics and balance tweaks, new enemies and more - there's a lot to look forward to in the upcoming updates. 

A lot of attention is also paid to optimization, so closer to release the game will run smoother on all systems.

We hope that this gives you a clearer idea of the direction the project is going in. Thank you for your patience and support - it gives us an incentive to move forward. Look forward to major updates and, of course, a full release.

[i]Don't forget to add Ocean Keeper to your wishlist, buy the game and join our growing community. See you soon![/i]

notes.title: Ultimate Update 0.8.0
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Guardians![/h2]
New major update 0.8.0! In this update, you'll find exciting new gameplay improvements, features and content that will take your underwater adventures to the next level. 

From all-new mechs and diggers to new enemies and iconic locations, there's plenty to explore and conquer. Whether you're diving into new challenges or upgrading your arsenal, this update promises deeper gameplay, more variety, and even more intense action.

Let's dive into the details:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/dcc999ec96eec04d9dbe4bf5b9e97660e91f3767.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/a49944502f2a108e7bb92fe20fe15a6bf922307a.jpg[/img]
This update introduces a completely redesigned mech system, bringing three different levels of mechs in depth. Each mech gets bigger and more powerful as you upgrade, visually transforming from compact blue to bold red. The more upgrades you buy in the hub, the more your mech evolves, visually demonstrating your progress and power.
[h3]Blue Mech[/h3]
Compact and efficient, the blue mech is your starter companion, perfect for your first dives into uncharted waters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/e205fa1054dd9e65a8533be81c1dd44fbafa64d8.gif[/img]
[h3]Yellow Mech[/h3]
The yellow mech is more powerful and resilient, showing increasing strength as you explore later waves of enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/259403c3facbb7fa01ee4b9e7926c7ffbab5fc9a.gif[/img]
[h3]Red Mech[/h3]
Real power. With its massive hull and imposing design, the red represents the progress of your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/c9360e732d942886d4920ea15ea04bca4d46a2ce.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/e2c4f031173f5cdee2ba1cea2228a1b82d6b1f8e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/326a3da6f644c9ca55069a6f14c5079e03d702d1.jpg[/img]
Our Diggers have gotten a new and improved look, now offering three levels of visual upgrades. Each level emphasizes armor and power, ranging from a neat blue to a formidable red. 

These Diggers will change in sync with your mech, complementing its atmosphere and declaring that you are fully prepared to conquer the depths. 

[h3]Blue Digger[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/8dc059a4ac75319e76375da0fdb2eb8d2e5188f8.gif[/img]
[h3]Yellow digger[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/037fb31354a143b34873c6887f94d44a1e1b5d30.gif[/img]
[h3]Red digger[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/b96c86ddba07b095caae1edb4e659457f83608e9.gif[/img]
[h3]New digger upgrades coming soon[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/a5626932be4c40064653c33403bd8c267e6f5dcb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/4e964dd328b69a470444e88f9c1acd69a947d0aa.png[/img]
[h3]Laboratory[/h3]
Here every corner holds the mysteries of the past. In the laboratory you will find traces of long forgotten experiments. Be careful, for there are mysteries lurking here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/d5c330dbc3e9d436c429566ba7c1193c62158045.gif[/img]
[h3]Empire State[/h3]
The underwater counterpart of the famous skyscraper, this mine is impressive in size. Make your way through its gloomy floors and solve all the mysteries hidden inside the skyscraper. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/6d24b000c46bac23561dd3bef2fb3b0b3cf1d885.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/b28ba2f29e15977e999441008df45527c2d23f9f.png[/img]

We’ve added destructible objects to make your Ocean Keeper experience even more immersive! 

Now, much of the environment can be broken down – from small crates to massive structures like dinosaur bones – bringing your surroundings to life as they react to the chaos you unleash. Destructible environments add extra thrills, making each dive more dynamic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/e79b0974acc8f70e8150b85c683a14118f954876.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/05cbc2d4aea6d92e295c36898d468d6bb1e98c8a.png[/img]

This update introduces new visual effects that make gameplay even more enjoyable! 
Now, when bullets hit enemies, [i]you see impact effects[/i] that add to the satisfying experience of each hit. 

Upon dying, [i]enemies now shatter into shards that float to the surface[/i], enhancing the atmosphere of combat. 
In addition, the [i]Worm and Stinger[/i] enemies now have unique [i]new attack effects[/i], making each encounter with them more visually dynamic.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/736d8d9c50b1b478f03c46d617242c4b4399876f.gif[/img]

We've also added [i]new ore physics[/i] for a more realistic underwater feel – now, ore reacts naturally to its surroundings.

Additionally, the visuals for the [i]focus arc have been reworked[/i], giving it a refreshed and sharper look to better highlight key moments in combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/eac66e25bcb76d11c0fe42ac6e0aac52d523cf82.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/9e13450a61d3a4914046842b9f09290a98c45f70.jpg[/img]

Meet the new enemy: Puddle! This larger, black-colored blob brings a new hazard to the battlefield. Upon defeat, it explodes, leaving behind an acidic puddle that deals damage if you stand in it. Watch your step!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/d5048236b98016b70dff935c175370c23bea239b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/3152fd27b279f0571c784427dd5bff4a68311123.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/a28879a5050eaf47a88c3fbc362270b506ca01f2.png[/img]
[h3]Main Rocket Gun[/h3]

[b]Napalm[/b] — Upon explosion, this chip leaves behind a fiery napalm pool that burns anything in its path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/c30379c6a1e1ebbf2871c3c9047a9ee7908f0d09.gif[/img]

[b]Electro[/b] — Release a chain of electric shocks that paralyze enemies. With this mod, you can control groups of foes, stunning them and stopping their attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/10e661d0b87c4dc6a4159ad0178e728f0b9bb8bf.gif[/img]

[b]Detonating[/b] — Prepare for a cascade of small explosions across the area. This chip spreads damage throughout the zone, eliminating everything in its wake.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/c2c85f844f8bc8bd611c8280b26587b65c53f821.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/e8c55578bfd6d2a734a501254dc5b832ceca2ee3.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Boss Body Movement After Death: Fixed a bug where the boss’s body continued to follow the mech’s movement after its defeat.
[*] Artifact Tutorial Window in Main Menu: Resolved an issue where the relic tutorial window would remain on-screen after returning to the main menu until the game was restarted.
[*] Missing Rock Collider: Repaired the missing collider on rocks, which allowed the mech to climb unintended surfaces.
[*] Meta-Currency Counter Missing in Customization: Fixed a bug where the meta-currency counter was absent in the customization menu.
[*] Floating Mine Launcher: Corrected an issue where mines launched from the Mine Launcher were appearing mid-air instead of on the ground.
[*] Drone Doesn't Carry All Ore: Fixed an issue where the drone would only carry one ore and dump the second ore instead of carrying both.
[*] Enemies Passing Through Objects: Fixed an issue where enemies could walk through certain objects due to missing NavMesh configurations.
[*] UI Fixes in Session Upgrades Menu: Adjusted the size of the “Session Upgrades” title across all languages and repositioned the currency and ore counters.
[*] Crab Boss Death Bug: Resolved an issue where, after defeating the crab boss, the wave wouldn’t end due to a looping animation bug.
[/list]
Thank you all for your continued feedback and support. As always, your input is instrumental in helping us improve the game. Keep exploring, and don’t forget to leave a review or share your thoughts on Discord. Stay tuned for more updates, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts!

See you in the depths!

notes.title: Major Wave Rebalance Update 0.6.5
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Ocean Keepers,
[/h2]

We've been closely monitoring your feedback and working hard to improve the game based on your invaluable insights. We understand the importance of creating a balanced and enjoyable experience, and we're thrilled to announce a significant rebalance update. 
Here’s what you can expect in this latest update:

[h3]Wave Rebalance

[/h3][b]Reduced Early Wave Difficulty:[/b]
We heard you loud and clear. The initial waves were a bit too challenging for many players, so we've toned them down. This adjustment is aimed at making the start of your journey smoother and more enjoyable, allowing new players to get acclimated to the game mechanics without feeling overwhelmed.

[b]Eliminated Randomness:
[/b]In the past, players experienced extreme fluctuations in enemy strength within the same wave, leading to unpredictable difficulty spikes. We've addressed this by smoothing out the difficulty, ensuring a more consistent and fair challenge across all waves. Now, each wave will have a more predictable and manageable progression.

[b]Increased Wave Dynamics:
[/b]To keep the gameplay engaging and dynamic, we've shortened the spawn intervals of mobs within waves. This means you'll face more consistent action, maintaining the intensity and excitement throughout your play sessions.

[b]Adjusted Scaling to Wave 30:
[/b]We've reworked the scaling of wave difficulty up to wave 30. The early game is now less punishing, giving you a better chance to build your strength. However, the final waves have been made a bit tougher and more intense, offering a satisfying climax to your adventure. You'll need to strategize and utilize your upgrades effectively to conquer these challenging final waves.

[b]Balanced Worm Boss:
[/b]The Worm Boss was previously a point of frustration for many players. We've balanced its damage output, ensuring that both its ranged attacks and jumping attacks are fair and challenging. This change applies to all waves where the Worm Boss appears, making for a more balanced and enjoyable boss fight.

[h3]Hub Store Improvements

[/h3][b]Revised Prices:[/b]
We've taken a close look at the prices of upgrades and made adjustments to better reflect their utility. This means that upgrades will now be priced more intuitively, offering better value for their impact on gameplay.

[b]Early Access to Upgrades:
[/b]One of the issues we identified was that players were not able to access upgrades quickly enough. To address this, players will now have access to several upgrades after their first run. This change ensures that you can start customizing and improving your mech early on, enhancing your overall experience.

[b]Reduced Grind:
[/b]To keep the game exciting and rewarding, we've significantly reduced the grind for upgrades. Now, after almost every run, you'll have the opportunity to unlock a new upgrade. This change aims to maintain a steady progression and keep the gameplay fresh and engaging.

[h3]Ongoing Balancing Efforts:
[/h3]

The balance changes introduced in this update are a hotfix addressing major issues. However, we consider this a work in progress. We will continue to fine-tune the game based on your feedback and further testing. Expect more comprehensive balancing changes in future updates, as we strive to create the best possible experience for you.

Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping these updates, and we’re committed to continuously improving the game. We appreciate your patience and support as we work through these changes. Please keep sharing your thoughts and suggestions — they truly make a difference.

We want to extend a special thank you to all our beta testers who have tirelessly reported bugs and provided invaluable feedback. Your contributions have been essential in getting us to this point.

[b]Stay with us, explore the depths, and enjoy the improved Ocean Keeper experience! 🌊✨[/b]

[h2]Hey Keepers![/h2]
The latest update, Version 0.5.16, is now live on Steam! This update focuses on refining the gameplay experience through crucial bug fixes, comprehensive balance adjustments, and the addition of new localization options. Here’s what’s included:

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Turret Upgrade Purchase Bug Fixed: Resolved an issue where players were unable to purchase the turret upgrade.

- [i]Localization Bugs Fixed:[/i]
[*]   Corrected font display issues.
[*]   Ensured proper text rendering in all pop-up windows.
[/list]
[b]Analytics Update:[/b]
[list]
[*] General Improvements: Updated our analytics to better track player progress and game performance, allowing for more informed decisions in future updates.
[/list]
[b]Balance Adjustments:[/b]

[i]- Wave Balance Changes:[/i]
[list]
[*]   Difficulty progression now follows a geometric curve, eliminating sudden spikes in enemy strength.
[*]   Debuffed projectile speed Worm and Stinger enemies.
[*]   Debuffed enemy group sizes - Blobs, Zombies, and Worms, making encounters more easy.
[/list]
- [i]Debuffed Beetle Boss:[/i]
  [list]
[*] Adjusted boss phases, previously, the boss phase changed the Beetle lost 800HP; now, it changes every 1000HP.
[*]   Extended attack window for the Boss's aerial attack, giving players a fair chance to dodge.
[/list]
- [i]Shotgun Enhancements:[/i]
 [list]
[*] Added a reload speed upgrade to improve combat efficiency, allowing players to maintain a higher rate of fire.
[/list]
[b]Localization Update:[/b]
The interface has been localized into the following languages:
[olist]
[*] Ukrainian
[*] English
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] German
[*] Spanish (Spain)
[*] Polish
[*] Swedish
[*] Portuguese (Brazil)
[*] Chinese (Traditional)
[*] Chinese (Simplified)
[*] rusian
[*] Korean
[/olist]
Enjoy the enhanced gameplay and fixes in Ocean Keeper's latest update. We appreciate your continued support and look forward to hearing your thoughts on these new changes.

notes.title: Update 0.5.14 Now Live!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Keepers!
[/h3]
We are pleased to announce the release of update 0.5.14, which brings a host of improvements, optimizations, and bug fixes to enhance your gameplay experience. This update focuses on refining game mechanics, fixing persistent issues, and providing a more polished and enjoyable gaming experience. Check out the full list of changes below:

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Invisible Walls Removed: Fixed the issue of invisible walls appearing in various locations that impeded player movement.
[*] Enemy Spawn Issue Resolved: Addressed the problem where enemies spawned in inaccessible areas, specifically within rocks.
[*] Statue of Liberty Model Visible: Fixed the bug preventing the Statue of Liberty model from rendering properly on the map.
[*] Late-Game FPS Drops Fixed: Resolved performance issues causing regular FPS drops during later stages of the game.
[/list]
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Localization Added: Added the option to select different languages through the settings menu. Players can now choose between English and Ukrainian.
[*] Updated Descriptions: Improved the description for the AutoRepair upgrade to provide a clearer explanation of its functionality. Additionally, updated descriptions for various UI elements to enhance clarity and understanding.
[/list]
Stay tuned for more updates and features as we continue to develop Ocean Keeper. We appreciate your support and feedback, which help us make the game better for everyone. Thank you and happy exploring!

notes.title: Update 0.5.13: Enhanced Graphics and Gameplay Balance
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Keepers!
[/h3]
We're excited to announce that update 0.5.13 has been uploaded to Steam! This update focuses on optimizing performance, balancing gameplay, and fixing several bugs to improve your overall experience. Here’s what’s included:

[b]Features:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized overall game graphics and memory usage: Improved rendering techniques and memory management to enhance performance and reduce lag.
[*] Updated balance for main weapons: Adjusted damage, fire rate, and ammo capacity for primary weapons to ensure a more balanced and engaging combat experience.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed optimization issue in later waves: Resolved performance drops and lag that occurred during higher enemy wave counts.
[*] Fixed worm spawning effect appearing over an abyss: Corrected the visual glitch where the worm spawn effect would incorrectly appear over gaps.
[*] Fixed green bugs passing through the mech's shield: Addressed the issue where green bug enemies could bypass the mech's defensive shield.
[*] Fixed UI fragment where the Guns tab in the hub would shift down in the tutorial.
[*] Fixed shadow display for the drill in the mine: Corrected the graphical error where the drill's shadow would not render properly in mining areas.
[*] Removed map areas where the mech could enter rock textures, making it unreachable by enemies.
[*] Fixed incorrect reload display during weapon upgrades: Fixed the bug where the reload progress was displayed incorrectly when upgrading weapons.
[*] Fixed shotgun and rocket launcher only reloading one ammo instead of the full magazine after the first reload.
[/list]

notes.title: 🚀 Update: Weapons & Skills Rework!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Keepers,[/b]

It's time for the [b]first Ocean Keeper update[/b], where we'll tell you about the latest features currently in development.

In our ongoing quest to bring you the most thrilling combat experience, we're excited to announce a significant update focused on enhancing the diversity and functionality of your arsenal. Our latest overhaul introduces a slew of new weapons and major updates to your mech-mounted auto-guns, all designed to elevate your strategic options and battlefield efficacy.

🔫 [b]Revamped Arsenal for Tactical Dominance[/b]

[list]
[*] Rocket Launchers & Electro-guns: We're reworking these to offer more varied tactical uses, ensuring that you can tailor your approach to each battle.
[*] Railguns: Expect more power and precision, turning each shot into a devastating delivery of justice against your foes.
[*] Machine Guns & Shotguns: We're polishing these staples of any mech's arsenal for smoother handling and better responsiveness.
[/list]

[b]We'd also like to highlight the new weapons added in the latest patch:[/b]

[b]Napalm Bomb Launcher:[/b] This beast fires three projectiles that create fiery pools, dealing continuous damage to any enemies that dare tread across them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/fa23ac59530251b4ed84b014e7707a4366079a8c.gif[/img]

[b]Sniper Rifle:[/b] This high-caliber weapon pierces through multiple enemies in a line, perfect for those who favor precision and power.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/fbb4fbe4a324b5e4fde1a99e5e3ed85c1e564d19.gif[/img]

[b]Jamming Missile Launcher:[/b] This sophisticated piece of artillery fires missiles that burst on impact, releasing an EMP-like pulse that slows all enemies within the area. It’s perfect for those critical moments when you need to halt an enemy advance and gain the upper hand.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/e619fcc29a9973aad5f6f18e30ada5802930f363.gif[/img]

[b]Detonation Charges:[/b] This weapon transforms your mech into a mobile artillery unit. Firing a missile that splits into multiple smaller bombs upon impact, it blankets the battlefield with explosions. Each cluster bomb is designed to maximize area coverage, ensuring no enemy escapes unscathed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/cfac50a360bbafed27f7e3dcc8ffa7ef2b61db2a.gif[/img]

🎯 [b]Upgrade Your Tactics[/b]
These enhancements are not just about raw power; they're about giving you the tools to craft more intricate battle plans and enjoy a more dynamic fight. Whether you're laying down suppressive fire with our improved machine guns or using the new railgun to snipe targets from afar, the power is in your hands. Customize your mech's loadout to match your preferred combat style, and take advantage of these cutting-edge weapons to dictate the pace of battle.

[b]Strategize and Customize Your Playstyle[/b]
We want you to feel the power at your fingertips, choosing weapons and skills that resonate with your personal gameplay style. With these updates, every player can find something that perfectly matches their strategy, whether you're about from a distance with Sniper Rifle, or diving straight into the fray with Napalm Bomb Launcher
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895678/482096420389d7c1e4c59d67dff854075ffa518b.png[/img]

🚀 [b]What's Next?[/b]
As we edge closer to the DEMO, this weapons system overhaul is a critical part of our final polishing efforts. We're dedicated to delivering a robust and thrilling combat experience that will keep you engaged right from the start.

Prepare for deployment, Keepers. The battlefield awaits, and with these new tools at your disposal, you are equipped to conquer any challenge. These enhancements are just a glimpse of what we have in store for you.

Thank you for your interest and support during this exciting phase of development. Keep an eye on our updates as we gear up for the official launch. The future of Ocean Keeper is nearly upon us, and we are thrilled to have you join us on this journey.
